glosses: peg (a short, thick piece of wood, metal, or other material)
dowel (a longer piece of wood, plastic, or other material)

examples.text: Hay un taco en la autopista.
examples.en: There is a traffic jam on the highway.

examples.text: El bus llegó tarde debido al taco.
examples.en: The bus was late because of the traffic jam.

examples.text: Si mencionan México, los tacos se me vienen a la mente.
examples.en: Mention Mexico, and tacos come to mind.

examples.text: A Tom no le gustan las chicas que usan tacos altos.
examples.en: Tom doesn't like girls who wear high heels.
